title: High-Performance Web Architecture & Core Web Vitals
description: Deep dive into rendering pipelines, memory profiling, bundle optimization, and latency budgeting.
longDescription: A rigorous technical masterclass tailored for full-stack engineers aiming to optimize sub-second user experiences. We cover DOM render tree construction, thread execution models, memory leak detection with Chrome DevTools, asset pipeline compression, dynamic imports, and modern server-driven architecture.
location: Auditorium A, Tech Hub Bengaluru & Virtual
speaker: Arjun Sundaram
speakerBio: Arjun leads web infrastructure at ScaleWorks and has architected platforms serving over 50 million concurrent users across Asia.
alt: Abstract technical architecture schematic with performance metrics

Laptop with Node.js 20+ and Chrome Canary installed
Basic understanding of browser network and performance panels
learningOutcomes: Master Chrome DevTools Performance Profiler and flame graph reading
Reduce Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
Implement advanced code splitting and Tree Shaking strategies
Eliminate main thread blocking execution

title: Zero-Trust Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes at Scale
description: Architect resilient Kubernetes clusters with mutual TLS, container sandboxing, and declarative GitOps.

speakerBio: Priya is an author and maintainer of CNCF sandbox tools with 12 years of production experience in mission-critical distributed systems.
alt: Cloud mesh topology and interconnected service nodes diagram
requirements: Familiarity with Docker and basic Linux command-line utilities
Git client and SSH keys configured on laptop
learningOutcomes: Deploy eBPF-powered network security policies using Cilium
Automate workload configuration with ArgoCD and Kustomize
Configure automated certificate management with Vault
Design fault-tolerant failovers for high-availability clusters

Ethical mindset for authorized security demonstrations only
